description: Answer a quote from a buyer by accepting it, sending a counter-price, or declining. Requires sign-in with seller access. The buyer is notified. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:write). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

action.description: Use accept when the buyer proposed a unit price. Use counter to offer the seller's unit price in cents, including when the buyer asked for pricing. Use decline to close the request.

counter_price.description: Seller's unit price in cents (required for counter).

message.description: Optional note sent to the buyer alongside the decision.

offer_valid_through.description: Optional last UTC date on which the buyer can accept this offer.

quote_request_id.description: Id of the quote request to answer, as returned by get_quote_requests.

name: respond_to_quote
title: Respond to a quote request
